name: AkuAuction refund-counter mismatch permanently locks project funds
summary: claimProjectFunds() required refundProgress to reach totalBids, but processRefunds() advanced refundProgress once per bidder entry while totalBids counted auction units. Once the refund sweep processed every bidder entry, refundProgress stopped at bidIndex below totalBids, so the withdrawal condition can never hold and the auction proceeds stay locked.
notes: The immutable AkuAuction runtime contains both processRefunds() and the unreachable claimProjectFunds() condition; nothing changed after deployment.

Loss is the balance left after the final refund batch (5,495 units at the 2.1 ETH closing price), unchanged since. Successful bidder refunds are not loss, and the temporary refund-griefing episode caused no permanent loss.
Anchored on the final refund batch: only once it exhausts every bidder entry is the counter mismatch irreversible and emergencyWithdraw() no longer an escape for the remaining balance.
